summary.intent: Fix a failing vault recovery E2E test in CI, then address a series of downstream CI failures (Grafana provisioning, Tauri signing, writable-shares test, GitHub Actions action version), and update outdated codebase docs for the new multi-package/crate architecture.
summary.outcome: All five CI failures were diagnosed and fixed (protobuf field bug, Grafana API key, Tauri signing keys, IPNS key ID mismatch in writable shares, tauri-action@v1 nonexistent), codebase docs were rewritten across 7 files for the current architecture, and the standalone build-desktop.yml workflow was removed.

repo: IPNS records use protobuf field 1 for the value (CID path) and field 2 for signatureV1 — recovery.html had these swapped in extractCidFromIpnsRecord
resolveIpns tried the slow IPFS gateway HEAD (15s timeout) before delegated routing — in CI where Kubo can't resolve mock-published names this caused cascading timeouts
Standalone file shares create a synthetic FilePointer with id=shareId, but file-ipns keys in share_keys are stored with itemId=fileId (real file UUID), causing IPNS key lookup to fail on write
TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY and TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD secrets existed in GitHub but were never passed to tauri-action steps in any of the three OS build jobs
tauri-apps/tauri-action@v1 does not exist — latest major version is v0 (v0.6.2); build-desktop.yml referenced @v1 causing startup_failure on every release event
The ThrottlerModule was hardcoded with fixed limits (100/min) — running the full E2E suite locally without relaxed throttling caused 429s that blocked account creation across test suites
The Grafana API key needed for dashboard provisioning is a service account token distinct from the Loki/Prometheus data source keys
build-desktop.yml workflow is redundant — desktop builds are handled by deploy-staging.yml on release; standalone workflow was removed by user decision

code.finding: extractCidFromIpnsRecord checked fieldNumber === 2 (signatureV1) instead of fieldNumber === 1 (value) when parsing IPNS protobuf records
After resp.json() consumes the body, the fallthrough path tried resp.arrayBuffer() on the same response — double-consume bug; fixed by wrapping protobuf parse in else branch
fetchWithRetry only retried on thrown errors, not on non-OK HTTP responses (429/5xx) — added !resp.ok check with sleep before retry
getFileIpnsKeyFn falls back to first file-ipns key when itemId doesn't match, scoped to itemType === 'file' shares only — safe because standalone file shares have exactly one file
ThrottlerModule converted from forRoot to forRootAsync with ConfigService injection — NODE_ENV=test sets limits to 200/sec and 2000/min, removing throttle interference from full E2E suite runs
Shared RECOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS constant used for both test timeout and assertion timeout to prevent assertion from firing before test timeout

workflow: Run web E2E tests locally with NODE_ENV=test on the API before pushing — throttle 429s caused false failures across all account-creation-dependent test suites
When a test timeout equals a network operation timeout, the test will always fail at the network layer before Playwright's assertion can fire — timeouts need to be staggered
The full local web-e2e suite has 3 environment-specific failures (Web3Auth MFA, IPFS timing, local auth) that also fail in development — these are not regressions
GitHub Actions startup_failure (zero jobs) indicates a workflow YAML parse error or nonexistent action reference, not a test failure
Docker Hub unauthorized errors on GitHub Actions runners are transient infrastructure issues — re-running failed jobs resolves them
Parallel Playwright suite runs against shared API/DB cause interference (account creation conflicts, state pollution) — suites must run sequentially

friction: Multiple CI round-trips to fix vault recovery test before reproducing locally — user explicitly called this out and required local verification before future commits
1Password SSH agent inaccessible from subprocess during commit signing attempts, requiring manual intervention
git index.lock stale lock file left by a crashed process blocked git operations
Full web-e2e suite ran in parallel with itself (background task + foreground run) causing test interference and false failures
Docker Hub auth failures (unauthorized) on GitHub Actions were transient but caused 4 job failures requiring manual re-run
The docs mapper agents produced MD036 (emphasis-as-heading) and bare code fence lint errors requiring a second fix pass before the commit could land
